Under the Irish Collective Asset-management Vehicles Act 2015, liabilities incurred on behalf of, or attributable to, a sub-fund must be discharged solely from that sub-fund’s assets. Assets of other sub-funds cannot be used to meet those liabilities.

Thus, an umbrella ICAV is **one legal entity with legally ring-fenced pools of assets and liabilities**, rather than a group of separate companies.
